jira_assignee_account_id.label: Agent Jira account ID (for mention detection)

jira_admin_token.label: Jira admin API token (optional, enables auto-configuration of statuses, fields, and screens)

jira_admin_user.label: Jira admin user email (owner of jira_admin_token; falls back to jira_user when unset)

todo_statuses.label: Jira statuses treated as To Do (JSON array)

attachment_download_limit.label: Max newest attachments auto-downloaded by jira_get_issue (0 = all)
